title: 第4章：肉铺
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“小孩，你叫啥名字？”

    “我叫马超。”

    “马超是吧，我先问你个问题，摆摊可不轻松，你能不能吃的了这个苦？”

    “我能！”马超重重点头，语气笃定。

    “嗯！”

    “行，那我就给你说说。”

    王大爷满意的点了点头，他指着附近的几个摊位，“咱们这摆摊的人，全是附近村上的农民，他们拿的是自己吃不完的菜过来摆摊，来这里卖菜顾客，全是附近几个小区的住户。”

    “这里摆摊虽然不要摊位费，但摆摊时间不能超过中午12点，还要负责把卫生搞好，一旦摆摊时间超过12点，城管就会过来撵人，弄不好还要罚款。”

    马超心想那就是一上午时间，但要是想多挣钱，肯定摆摊时间越长越好。

    “那要是想摆摊时间长一点怎么办？”

    “可以去前面的农贸市场，那里有固定的摊位出租，每个月几百到几千不等，一直到农贸市场关门。”

    马超眼睛亮了，农贸市场的确是个好选择，不过他现在一穷二白，根本拿不出这个世界的钱去租摊位。

    看来自己只能暂时在这里摆摊挣钱。

    不过，王大爷的话却在马超心里埋下了一颗种子，他朝王大爷鞠了一躬，“谢谢王大爷。”

    “哎呀，这是干啥。”

    “好了好了，小超，你要是哪天来摆摊，就把摊子放我旁边，到时候我还能教教你。”

    “谢谢，谢谢王大爷。”

    马超又有些迟疑，“那会不会影响你的生意？”

    话落，周围几个摊主全都笑了。

    王大爷摆了摆手，“我摆摊又不指望挣多少钱，影响个啥。”

    “你就听老王的，他几个子女都有出息，在这里摆摊卖菜，就是为了打发时间。”

    “小超，你不用顾忌我们，尽管过来摆摊就是了，不影响的。”

    听大家伙都这么说，马超总算放心了，“谢谢，谢谢大家。”

    “我明天一早就赶过来。”

    “不用急，晚点也没事，位置我给你留着。”

    “好。”

    马超握了握拳，总算成功迈出了第一步，他已经迫不及待想回去挖野菜了。

    时间就是金钱，对马超来说，这是给父亲治腿的希望。
content_en:
"Kid, what's your name?"

    "My name is Ma Chao."

    "Ma Chao, right? Let me ask you a question first. Setting up a stall is not easy. Can you bear the hardship?"

    "I can!" Ma Chao nodded heavily with a firm tone.

    "Yeah!"

    "Okay, then I'll tell you."

    Uncle Wang nodded with satisfaction and pointed to several nearby stalls. "The people setting up stalls here are all farmers from nearby villages. They bring the vegetables they can't finish to set up stalls. The customers who come here to sell vegetables are all residents of several nearby communities."

    "Although there is no stall fee for setting up stalls here, the stall opening time cannot exceed 12 noon, and you must also be responsible for good hygiene. Once the stall opening time exceeds 12:00, the urban management will come to evict people, and if they fail to do so, they will be fined."

    Ma Chao thought that it would only take one morning, but if he wanted to make more money, he would definitely set up the stall as long as possible.

    "Then what if I want to set up the stall for a longer time?"

    "You can go to the farmer's market in front, where there are fixed stalls for rent, ranging from a few hundred to a few thousand per month, until the farmer's market closes."

    Ma Chao's eyes lit up. The farmer's market was indeed a good choice, but he was so broke now that he couldn't spend the money in the world to rent a stall.

    It seems that I can only make money by setting up a stall here temporarily.

    However, Uncle Wang's words planted a seed in Ma Chao's heart, and he bowed to Uncle Wang, "Thank you, Uncle Wang."

    "Oh, what is this?"

    "Okay, okay, Xiao Chao, if you come to set up a stall someday, put the stall next to me, and I can teach you then."

    "Thank you, thank you, Uncle Wang."

    Ma Chao hesitated again, "Will that affect your business?"

    As soon as he finished speaking, several stall owners around him all laughed.

    Uncle Wang waved his hand, "I don't expect to make much money when I set up a stall, so what's the impact?"

    "Just listen to Lao Wang. Several of his children are promising. They set up stalls here to sell vegetables just to pass the time."

    "Xiaochao, you don't have to worry about us, just come over and set up a stall, it won't affect us."

    After hearing what everyone said, Ma Chao finally felt relieved, "Thank you, thank you all."

    "I'll be here early tomorrow morning."

    "Don't worry, it'll be fine if it's late. I'll save the spot for you."

    "Okay."

    Ma Chao clenched his fists and finally took the first step. He couldn't wait to go back and dig wild vegetables.

    Time is money, and for Ma Chao, this is the hope of treating his father's leg.
